name: Kanrinin-san wa Miboujin
source:
The protagonist, Hirayama Riku, is a poor student who is living at a run-down apartment. There are 3 reasons why he is living here: the university is near, the rent is cheap and most of all, the manager is cute.

However, she is nearly a decade older than him. Also, although she is a widow, she still thinks about her husband even now. One day, a beautiful woman moves next door and discovers his love for the manager.

"So you like the manager huh? Then big sister will help you!"

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc037/top.html#story]Official site[/url]]
